comment: Cue names to files, for `sound` beats and per-stage music. Adding a track is an edit here, not a code change. Roles: bed = plays under a whole stage, cue = short musical sting, seam = plays between stages (build-up, hand-off, curtain), sfx = one-off effect. `skill` names the show skill a cue accompanies. Ids ending -1/-2/-3 are alternate takes of the same prompt; `take` groups them.
